description: This file defines Express routes for user-related operations, including self-profile management for authenticated users and admin-only user management functions such as retrieve, update, delete, set role, and set status.

methods.name: me
methods.description: Handles retrieval of the current user's profile.

methods.name: updateMe
methods.description: Handles updates to the current user's profile.

methods.name: deleteMe
methods.description: Handles deletion of the current user's profile.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves user information for admin with specified ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates user information for admin with specified ID.

methods.name: setRole
methods.description: Sets the role of user with specified ID.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of user with specified ID.
